chunks: Muhammad ibn Ibrahim (may God have mercy on him) narrated to us, he said: Ahmad ibn Muhammad al-Hamadani informed us, from Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from his father, from Abu al-Hasan Ali ibn Musa al-Rida (peace be upon him),

that a man from the people of Khurasan said to him: O son of the Messenger of God! I saw the Messenger of God (may God bless him and his family) in a dream, as though he was saying to me: 'How will you be when a part of me is buried in your land, and you are entrusted to guard my trust, and my star is hidden in your soil?' So al-Rida (peace be upon him) said to him: I am the one buried in your land, and I am a part of your Prophet, and I am the trust and the star. Indeed, whoever visits me while knowing what God, blessed and exalted, has made obligatory regarding my right and obedience to me, then I and my forefathers will be his intercessors on the Day of Resurrection. And whoever has us as his intercessors will be saved, even if his sins are equal to the burden of the two weighty beings — the Jinn and mankind.

And indeed, my father narrated to me, from my grandfather, from his father (peace be upon them), that the Messenger of God (may God bless him and his family) said: 'Whoever sees me in his dream has truly seen me, because Satan cannot take my form, nor the form of any of my successors, nor the form of any of their followers. And indeed, a true vision is one part out of seventy parts of prophethood.'

key_terms.الرؤيا الصادقة: The true vision — a dream that carries genuine spiritual significance, considered part of prophethood
key_terms.بضعة: A part or piece — used by the Prophet to refer to his descendants as extensions of himself
key_terms.شفعاء: Intercessors — those who will advocate on behalf of believers on the Day of Judgment
key_terms.وديعة: Trust or deposit — referring to the Imam as a prophetic trust entrusted to the people of Khurasan

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Rida say about the reward of visiting his shrine?
ai.summary: Imam al-Rida (AS) affirmed to a man from Khurasan that he is the prophetic trust buried in their land — referring to his future burial in Tus (modern-day Mashhad, Iran). The Imam promised divine intercession on the Day of Judgment for those who visit his shrine with knowledge of his divinely-mandated rights. He also transmitted a prophetic hadith confirming that true dreams cannot be counterfeited by Satan.

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. Ibrahim (rh) narrated to us. He said: Ahmad b. Muhammad al-Hamadani informed us from `Ali b. al-Hasan b. `Ali b. Faddal from his father from Abi'l Hasan `Ali b. Musa al-Rida (as).

A man from the people of Khurasan said to him: O son of the Messenger of Allah! I saw the Messenger of Allah (s) in a dream, and it was as though he was saying to me: "How will you be when a part of me is buried in your land, and you are asked to protect my trust, and my star disappears in your land?" So, al-Rida (as) said to him: I am the one buried in your land, and I am the piece of your Prophet, and I am the trust and the star. Surely, whoever visits me, knowing what Allah has obligated with regards to my rights and obedience to me, I and my forefathers will be his intercessor on the Day of Resurrection. Whoever has us as their intercessor will be delivered, even his sins are equal to that of the two heavyweights - the Jinn and mankind.

Surely, my father narrated from my grandfather from his father (as) that the Messenger of Allah (s) said: "Whoever sees me in his dream has truly seen me, for Satan cannot take on my form, nor the form of any of my deputies, nor the form of any of their Shi`a. Surely, a true vision is one part out of seventy parts of prophethood."
